name: 外链检测 Backlink Guard
description: Vet link sources before you submit, verify listings, and audit your backlinks for link spam.
description_zh: 提交外链前查来源是不是垃圾站，上线后查链接在不在、传不传权重，再给自己的外链做垃圾外链体检。部分工具免费，其余用你自己的 Glasser 或 AIsa key 按量付费，本机需装 uv。
description_en: Check a link source before you submit, verify the link once it is live, and audit your own backlinks against Google's link spam policies. Some tools are free; the rest buy data with your own Glasser or AIsa key. Needs uv on the machine.
examples_zh: 我要把产品提交到几个目录站，先免费帮我查查哪些不该交：（贴上网址）
看看这个页面有没有链接到我的网站，传不传权重：（页面地址）
给我的网站做一次外链体检，看看有没有垃圾外链
我的两个竞品最近拿到了哪些外链，是我还没有的？
Google 的 AI 概览在我的关键词上都引用了哪些网站？
examples_en: I want to submit my product to a few directories. Check for free which ones to skip: (paste the URLs)
Does this page link to my site, and does the link pass ranking credit? (page URL)
Audit my site's backlinks for link spam
Which links did my two competitors get recently that I don't have?
Which sites do Google's AI Overviews cite for my keywords?
